evidence: A satisfying settlement holds launch authorization, states that the AGPL-licensed M-17 is replaced before external customer access, prohibits model training, deletes content after 30 days, limits use to an administrative workflow tool only, requires SOC 2 Type II before production, requires an annual audit right, and cites PF1 after PF1 is revealed. A plausible incomplete settlement using standard templates would fail the M-17, privacy, intended-use, or contracting checks.
